sections.text_helper: Section 5.6.11 "RAMCFG memory 2 write protection register 3 (RAMCFG_M2WPR3)" in chapter 5 (RAMs configuration controller (RAMCFG)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 123.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x070
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 PyWP: SRAM2 1-Kbyte page y write protection (y = 95 to 64)
These bits are set by software and cleared only by a global RAMCFG reset.
0: Write protection of SRAM2 1-Kbyte page y is disabled.
1: Write protection of SRAM2 1-Kbyte page y is enabled.
